name: RepoHelp
author: AfterWorld
short: Browse help by repository, cog, and command.
description: Replaces the existing help formatter with repository dropdowns, paginated cog and command navigation, and permission-aware listings. Detailed command help remains Red's native help.
install_msg: Load with [p]load repohelp, then use [p]help. Unload any other custom help cog first. [p]unload repohelp restores standard help.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store end-user data. Help sessions exist in memory until timeout or unload.
